nodes.name: NH3 diffusion precipitation Fe2+Ni2+
nodes.procedure: An aqueous solution containing precursor (5 mM FeCl2·4H2O and 15 mM NiCl2) was prepared by dissolving the metal salts in deionized water (40 mL). After ultrasonic dissolution, the vial (50 mL) was put into a sealed blue cap bottle (100 mL) with 2 mL concentrated ammonium hydroxide solution. After the diffusion of 12 hours at room temperature, the precipitate found at the bottom of the vial was washed by centrifugation (9000 rpm, 5 min) with Milli-Q water for two times, and dried at room temperature.

After ultrasonic dissolution, 2 mL NaOH solution (1 M) was added into the reaction solution. The vial (50 mL) was put into a sealed blue cap bottle (100 mL). After the reaction of 12 hours at room temperature, the precipitate found at the bottom of the vial was washed by centrifugation (9000 rpm, 5 min) with Milli-Q water for two times, and dried at room temperature.
